title: Atlas Dissertation Node Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter of a dissertation node (dissertation/*.md). The tree is built solely from parent + order. v2 (ADR-0004, issue #53): nodes link the user's own Publications via `publications` (allowed on any kind); the direct `paper_ref` Cite-Key link is dropped — the startup migration surfaces old values as a warning list for manual re-linking, never auto-converted. `paper-slot` stays as a semantic placeholder kind.

parent.description: id of the parent node; null = root.

publications.description: IDs of the user's own Publications (veroeffentlichungen/*.md) this node is planned around. Allowed on any kind. Hanging IDs are warnings, never auto-repaired.
